| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| AU\_OK | Complete derivation selected and actions evaluated; value may be null. |
| AU\_SYNTAX | All permitted alternatives exhausted without complete recognition. |
| AU\_LIMIT | Search or native-recursion budget exhausted; membership undecided. |
| AU\_NOMEM | Committed-tree evaluation could not allocate required storage. |
| AU\_INVALID | Invalid API arguments, such as null input or unsupported depth limit. |
